text: Delegate a task, then review the diff and merge it from the app or terminal
quote: Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge from the App or your terminal.

text: Provides an official CLI (Droid CLI) to run Factory from terminal, editor, tests, and git workflow
quote: Use the Droid CLI to run Factory from your terminal, editor, tests, and Git workflow.

text: Bash mode lets you run raw shell commands directly without AI interpretation
quote: Press ! to toggle bash mode and run shell commands directly without AI interpretation.

text: Connects to Jira, Notion, Slack, Linear, PagerDuty and MCP tools to sync development with team systems
quote: Connect Jira, Notion, Slack, Linear, PagerDuty, and MCP tools to keep development synchronized with team systems

text: Lets you delegate scoped tasks to custom droids and package reusable procedures as skills
quote: delegate scoped tasks to Custom Droids via /droids, and package reusable procedures as Skills with /skills or /create-skill

text: droid exec runs as a one-shot headless command suited for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch processing
quote: droid exec runs as a one-shot command that completes a task and exits, making it ideal for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch processing.

text: droid exec supports tiered autonomy levels controlling which operations run without manual confirmation
quote: Droid exec uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation.

text: Can take a shared mockup and implement it directly with no engineering handoff
quote: A designer shares a mockup, and the system implements it without handoffs.

text: Readiness report command evaluates how ready a repository is for autonomous agents
quote: Run the /readiness-report slash command in a Factory App web or desktop session, or in the Droid CLI, to evaluate a repository's readiness level

text: Readiness-fix command automatically fixes failing agent-readiness criteria
quote: Automatically fix failing criteria with the /readiness-fix slash command in a Factory App web or desktop session, or in the Droid CLI

text: Factory Missions let you plan and execute large, multi-feature projects with structured orchestration
quote: Use Factory Missions to plan and execute large, multi-feature projects with structured orchestration.

text: Software Factory view shows the delivery lifecycle as an automation coverage map
quote: Open Software Factory to see your delivery lifecycle as an automation coverage map.

text: Documented API to create and drive droid sessions, managing lifecycle, settings, and messages
quote: Create and drive Droid sessions: manage their lifecycle, settings, and messages.

text: Can filter tasks/sessions by connected integration such as GitHub, Slack, Linear, and GitLab
quote: Filter by integration, including GitHub, Slack, Linear, and GitLab.

text: No installation required — cloud session sync and Droid Computers make sessions available from any browser
quote: Nothing to install: cloud session sync and Droid Computers make your sessions available from any browser at app.factory.ai.
